# Every non-blank line below the heading holds two sentences

Two sentences on one line. This is the second.
A question first? Then an answer.
An exclamation! Then more.
A sentence ends after code `pnpm test`. Then another starts.
A sentence before code. `pnpm lint` starts the next one.
Quotes close the first "sentence." Then another starts.
Parentheses close the first (like this.) Then another starts.
A bold status follows the sentence. **Done.**
A link ends the first [sentence](docs/a.md). The second follows.
A number can start the next sentence. 15 checks passed.
A non-ASCII capital can too. Ærø is an island.
- A list item with two sentences. The second belongs on its own line.
  A continuation line with two sentences. The second belongs on its own line.
- **A run-in label.** The text after it. Then a second sentence.
1. A numbered item with two sentences. The second belongs on its own line.
> A quote with two sentences. The second belongs on its own line.
